turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: (Sipping coffee, leaning back in my chair) Ah, the art world. It's a jungle out there, my friend. The collectors, the galleries, the artists - all vying for attention, all clamoring to be the next big thing. And I'm afraid that, in this cutthroat environment, the art world has become increasingly...refined. The market demands innovation, experimentation, and above all, originality. Anything less is simply...pedestrian. (Raising an eyebrow) Tell me, what do you have to offer that's truly groundbreaking?
